params.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic photo, square frame, split composition. Left half: a grey, washed-out, empty office - abandoned desks, switched-off monitors, cardboard boxes, cold dull light. Right half: the same office bursting with warm golden light where a sleek black-and-gold robot hands a thick stack of cash to a smiling young man in a hoodie holding a laptop. Strong contrast between the dull left and the radiant right. Vivid saturated colors, rich warm golden and amber light with hot orange highlights, high contrast, crisp detail, cinematic, energetic. The upper 42% of the frame is a deeper warm gradient (amber to near-black) so a white headline reads clearly. No text, no letters, no logos, no green.
